UserObject.mermaidData:
{
  "data": "sequenceDiagram
  actor A as Admin
  actor L as Lecturer
  actor S as Student
  participant UI as Web UI / Public UI
  participant Auth as Supabase Auth
  participant API as Backend API
  participant Store as Supabase Storage
  participant DB as Supabase
  participant LLM as LLM

  %% Admin uploads materials
  A->>UI: Upload course info + slides (PDF or PPTX)
  activate UI
  UI->>API: POST /api/materials/upload
  activate API
  API->>Store: Upload to bucket course-materials
  activate Store
  Store-->>API: storage_path
  deactivate Store
  API->>API: Extract text + chunk + embed
  API->>DB: INSERT materials + material_chunks
  activate DB
  DB-->>API: Saved
  deactivate DB
  API-->>UI: 201 Created
  deactivate API
  UI-->>A: Show success
  deactivate UI

  %% Lecturer logs in via Google OAuth
  L->>UI: Click "Sign in with Google"
  activate UI
  UI->>Auth: Initiate Google OAuth
  activate Auth
  Auth-->>L: Redirect to Google consent
  deactivate Auth
  L->>Auth: Authorize
  activate Auth
  Auth->>Auth: Read role from auth.users
  Auth-->>UI: Return JWT session
  deactivate Auth
  UI->>Auth: Persist session
  activate Auth
  Auth-->>UI: Session
  deactivate Auth

  alt role == lecturer
    UI-->>L: Redirect to /lecturer/dashboard
  else role == admin
    UI-->>L: Redirect to /admin/dashboard
  else role == student
    UI-->>L: Redirect to /student/dashboard
  else no role
    UI-->>L: Show error: unauthorized account
  end
  deactivate UI

  %% Lecturer generates mini-course (preview then confirm)
  L->>UI: Create course
  activate UI
  UI->>API: POST /api/courses/preview
  activate API
  API->>DB: Retrieve relevant chunks (pgvector)
  activate DB
  DB-->>API: chunks
  deactivate DB
  API->>LLM: Generate lesson with [S#] + MCQ quiz
  activate LLM
  LLM-->>API: Lesson + quiz
  deactivate LLM
  API-->>UI: Preview
  deactivate API
  UI-->>L: Show preview
  deactivate UI

  alt insufficient context
    API-->>UI: 409 Conflict
    UI-->>L: Show error: materials not indexed
  end

  L->>UI: Click Confirm
  activate UI
  UI->>API: POST /api/courses/confirm
  activate API
  API->>DB: INSERT mini_courses + quizzes + questions
  activate DB
  DB-->>API: courseId
  deactivate DB
  API-->>UI: 201 Created
  deactivate API
  UI-->>L: Show "Ready"
  deactivate UI

  %% Lecturer shares
  L->>UI: Click Share
  activate UI
  UI->>API: Set status='Shared', generate share_token
  activate API
  API->>DB: UPDATE mini_courses
  activate DB
  DB-->>API: Saved
  deactivate DB
  API-->>UI: share URL /s/{token}
  deactivate API
  UI-->>L: Display share link
  deactivate UI

  %% Student accesses and submits
  S->>UI: Open /s/{token}
  activate UI
  UI->>API: GET /api/public/course/:token
  activate API
  API->>DB: SELECT mini_courses + quizzes + questions
  activate DB
  DB-->>API: lesson + questions
  deactivate DB
  API-->>UI: lesson + quiz
  deactivate API
  UI-->>S: Display lesson and quiz
  deactivate UI

  S->>UI: Submit name + answers
  activate UI
  UI->>API: POST /api/public/course/:token/submit
  activate API
  API->>API: Validate name + answers

  alt name invalid
    API-->>UI: 400 Bad Request
    UI-->>S: Show validation message
  else name valid
    alt missing answers
      API-->>UI: 422 Unprocessable Entity
      UI-->>S: Prompt to complete unanswered
    else all answers provided
      API->>API: Calculate score, pass/fail
      API->>DB: INSERT quiz_attempts
      activate DB
      DB-->>API: attemptId
      deactivate DB
      API-->>UI: Score + explanations + pass/fail
      UI-->>S: Display result
    end
  end
  deactivate API
  deactivate UI

  %% Lecturer views analytics
  L->>UI: Open Analytics
  activate UI
  UI->>API: GET /api/analytics/:courseId
  activate API
  API->>DB: Aggregate attempts + question metadata
  activate DB
  DB-->>API: rows
  deactivate DB

  alt no submissions
    API-->>UI: empty list
    UI-->>L: Display "No submissions yet"
  else submissions exist
    API-->>UI: CourseAnalytics (KPIs, score dist, topic / Bloom / SOLO, cross-matrix, attempts)
    UI-->>L: Render dashboard
  end
  deactivate API
  deactivate UI
",
  "config": null
}

UserObject.mermaidData:
{
  "data": "sequenceDiagram
  actor A as Admin / Lecturer
  participant UI as Web UI
  participant API as Backend API
  participant Store as Supabase Storage
  participant DB as Supabase

  A->>UI: Enter course info + select file (PDF or PPTX)
  A->>UI: Click Save/Upload
  activate UI
  UI->>API: POST /api/materials/upload (multipart)
  activate API
  API->>API: Validate file type

  alt invalid file type
    API-->>UI: 400 Bad Request
    UI-->>A: Show validation error
  else valid
    API->>Store: Upload to bucket course-materials
    activate Store
    Store-->>API: storage_path
    deactivate Store
    API->>DB: INSERT materials (status='Processing')
    activate DB
    DB-->>API: ok
    deactivate DB
    API->>API: Extract text + chunk + embed
    API->>DB: INSERT material_chunks (with embeddings)
    activate DB
    DB-->>API: ok
    deactivate DB
    API->>DB: UPDATE materials SET status='Active'
    activate DB
    DB-->>API: ok
    deactivate DB
    API-->>UI: 201 Created
    UI-->>A: Display success
  end
  deactivate API
  deactivate UI
",
  "config": null
}
